headline: Maui County Cost of Government Commission

meeting.body: Maui County Cost of Government Commission
meeting.summary: The commission approved draft minutes, backed a 15% budget increase request, and deferred a West Maui Greenway study group so its scope can be refined.
meeting.recap: Items needing a vote were moved up because the commission would have a quorum only until 11:00 a.m.[[0:02:02]] Members present unanimously approved the draft minutes of the last meeting.[[0:06:29]] The interim chair said he told the county auditor he wants the commission's budget raised by 15%.[[0:07:31]] He said the technical writer will likely have more work, so the contract may need changes.[[0:08:13]] Commissioners who spoke said they support the 15% increase.[[0:08:51]] A commissioner proposed a temporary investigative group, a small team that works on its own and reports back, to study the West Maui Greenway project.[[0:10:54]] He said the project is further along than any other capital project he knows of but has not been carried out.[[0:12:28]] Another commissioner said the plan is very broad and the commission needs more meetings to understand it first.[[0:14:00]] The interim chair said he was uncomfortable forming the group before its scope is changed based on the discussion.[[0:54:21]] The item was put off so the interim chair and the proposing commissioner can bring back a refined scope.[[0:56:07]] The commission lost its quorum when a commissioner left.[[0:58:18]] The next meeting is set for January 9th at 10:00 a.m.[[1:01:43]]
decided: The agenda was rearranged without objection to take up items needing a vote first and to defer the chair and vice chair elections.
Members present approved the draft meeting minutes in a unanimous vote.
meeting.next: Elections for chair and vice chair were put off until the January meeting. The interim chair said no one will be invited in for January so the commission can focus on its boards and commissions study.
